name: Newhaven, Healer
desc1: This small, stark stone chamber is bereft of even the simple
desc2: ornamentation, and its bare walls gleam in the bright light of the
desc3: torches lining its walls. A short, stocky man with a black beard sits
desc4: behind a large stone table at the far end of the room. There is an
desc5: iron washbasin and some simple, utilitarian items used in the healing
desc6: profession lie at his side. You can exit the chamber to the east,
desc7: where faint sounds of metal hitting metal can be heard.
